brief: Explain why a sample percentage budget must be adapted when essential costs exceed its allowance.

title.es-MX: Un porcentaje es un punto de partida
title.pt-BR: Uma porcentagem é um ponto de partida

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "A percentage is a starting point"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Un porcentaje es un punto de partida"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Uma porcentagem é um ponto de partida"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Explain why a sample percentage budget must be adapted when essential costs exceed its allowance.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Adapt a sample budget to actual essential costs and available income.
instruction.misconception: Treating an illustrative percentage split as a requirement that overrides actual needs or creates missing income.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A sample percentage suggests an allocation. It does not lower actual rent or guarantee that essential costs fit.
Actual obligations must stay visible when adapting the guide.
Actual costs exceed the sample share by 60.
A target share does not create the money to fund it.
Equal income does not imply equal unavoidable costs.
A useful guide accommodates the stated access requirement.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
